thread:
marta: quick follow-up from PM — tracking owners for streaming/chat reliability items: timeouts, partial chunks, reconnects, and heartbeat/session expiry. I'm consolidating here so we can tick boxes.
ryan: thanks. can we prioritize: 1) client reconnect/batch resume 2) server partial-detect + alerting 3) session heartbeat/lease renewal 4) circuit-breaker to avoid thundering restarts? owners + ETA?
katie: i'll take client reconnect + resume. plan: add client-side ack + resume token, jittered exp backoff, and a small integration that simulates intermittent packet drops. ETA: draft PR by Fri EOD.
ali: will do server partial detection and add metric stream.partial_gap and an alert with 1m throttle. also adding optional auto-replay request endpoint for clients to fetch missing chunks. ETA: 10 days.
marta: heartbeat: we saw sessions expire after 30s of gap causing partials. propose a lightweight ping/ack every 15s + server-side lease extension. who wants heartbeat?
katie: i'll add client heartbeat and make it configurable. default 15s, opt-out allowed. note: heartbeat increases connection count slightly—ops?
ops-bot: :warning: FYI: enabling heartbeat will increase TCP churn; notify eng-infra if connection counts increase >5% during canary. File ticket.
ryan: i'll own rollout gating + circuit-breaker policy. plan: circuit-breaker on client errors > 10% over 5m per route, open for 2m. Canary: us-west-2 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 4h; rollback triggers: 5xx +0.5% or p50 latency +150ms.
katie: config snippet for reconnect/heartbeat I'll add to PR:
```yaml
client:
  reconnect:
    strategy: exp_jitter
    initial_ms: 50
    max_ms: 2000
    max_attempts: 6
  heartbeat:
    enabled: true
    interval_ms: 15000
```
ali: detection pseudo:
```
if chunk.seq != last_seq + 1:
  emit metric: stream.partial_gap
  start timer T=200ms
if T expires and no continuation:
  emit alert S-PartialGap-1
  write replay cursor to s3 for manual fetch
```
ali: also adding a Grafana panel that correlates partial_gap with session_heartbeat_miss and lb_conn_resets
marta: owners summary: katie=client reconnect + heartbeat (2654321010-PR), ali=server partial detect + replay (2654321022-PR), ryan=rollout + circuit-breaker (2654321035-ticket). Everyone please paste PR/ticket links here when created and update status weekly.
katie: creating draft PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/streaming-sdk/pull/621 (ci running). will add migration notes for SDK consumers.
ali: draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/streaming-router/pull/345 — adds metric, replay endpoint, and alert rules. ETA Mon.
ryan: filing infra ticket for canary + LB notes. will post link.
marta: final ask: start a bi-weekly "streaming incident digest" to review partial_gap trends and heartbeat misses over past 14 days and assign any new follow-ups. adding oncall + infra + eng-runtime. thanks all :pray:
